title: rescue-sse-chunk-ledger-and-toolcall-ordering
author: Aisha Morgan
description: Motivation: customer reports and internal fuzzing showed rare but reproducible cases where SSE fragments produced by the OpenAI-compat layer would lose a trailing delimiter during transient backpressure, causing downstream JSON reassembly to drop the final object or reorder function/tool-call sentinel events. This manifested as partial JSON payloads or tool call payloads appearing in the wrong sequence. This change introduces a compact chunk-ledger that tracks fragment offsets and a lightweight checksum/tag to guarantee deterministic reassembly and preserve user-visible event ordering, especially across retry/handshake/heartbeat boundaries. Approach: 1) Add a chunk ledger attached to each streaming session that records sequence id, byte offset, and a 16-bit tag computed over the fragment payload. 2) Emit an explicit re-sync sentinel when a fragment is trimmed by backpressure or when the SSE connection receives an incomplete terminal delimiter. 3) Ensure tool/function call sentinel ordering by attaching an incrementing event ordinal to call-sentinel events and replaying buffered fragments in ordinal order on reconnect. 4) Harden the SSE parser state machine to treat consecutive delimiters and empty events as explicit no-ops instead of merging them, avoiding delimiter collapse bugs. 5) Add compatibility shims so legacy clients see identical event boundaries (preamble emitted only when ledger attached). Testing and rollout: end-to-end harness added to the openai-compat SSE testbed exercising partial-JSON, heartbeat, and reconnect scenarios; a small canary on dedicated-hosted traffic for 48h followed by full cutover. Impact/risk: small increase in per-session metadata (ledger ~200-400 bytes), negligible CPU impact for tag checks, prevents several classes of data-loss bugs. Linear/incident: ENG-4921 is the root ticket and SUP-7682 reproducer attached.
commits: create chunk ledger and tag algorithm (mempool ledger + tests)
emit resync sentinel on trimmed fragments
add event-ordinal to toolcall sentinels and replay ordering tests
parser: prevent delimiter collapse and treat empty events as no-op
